name: JCC Milwaukee Mah Jongg
description: Drop-in Mah Jongg at the Harry & Rose Samson Family JCC in Whitefish Bay (North Shore, next to Fox Point). Page says: 'the American adaptation of Mah Jongg' using 'a card of Standard Hands' updated annually by the National Mah Jongg League. Newcomers can learn from experienced players. Ages 18+; light snacks provided.
address: 6255 N. Santa Monica Blvd., Whitefish Bay, WI 53217
schedule: Mondays 12:00-3:00 PM; $3 JCC members / $4 community participants (per page)

name: Whole Foods Prospect Ave Mah Jongg
description: Weekly open play at Whole Foods Market Prospect Ave in Milwaukee. Only evidence is the Order of the Tile directory (lists style as American Mah Jongg); not confirmed on a host or venue page.

name: Four Winds Lounge
description: Mah Jongg lounge at Bayshore Mall offering lessons for beginners through advanced players, socials and corporate events. Own page says 'Learn the game that is sweeping the nation' but does not name American/NMJL; the Order of the Tile directory lists it as American Mah Jongg.
address: 5710 N Centerpark Way, Bayshore Mall, Glendale, WI
schedule: Lounge hours Wed-Thu 12-8 PM; Fri 10 AM-6 PM; Sat 10 AM-3 PM. Registration via fourwindslounge.mahjpass.com

name: Nicolet Recreation Department Mah Jongg
description: Nicolet Rec Dept (Fox Point/North Shore) ran 'Mah Jongg For Beginners' at Nicolet Union High School in June-July 2025 (past). Patch quotes it as teaching 'National Mah Jongg League rules'; fee included the current NMJL card. No current session found.
address: Nicolet Union High School, Glendale, WI
schedule: 2025 session Tuesdays June 17-July 8, 6:00-8:30 PM ($79 resident / $89 non-resident); no current date confirmed
